summary: Full backend + frontend regression on the iter-5 batch (no topics-limit, Premium-only mini lessons, Home ESPLORA tile, credit-badge timer-on-tap, RecapCard cleanup, story-morph, ending viewport, /premium compare table, profile mode-switch-lessons). Backend: 4/4 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_lessons_gate.py: (a) POST /api/user/interests with 7 specific ids → 200 (no more 402 topics_limit); (b) free user with content_modes=['lessons'] → /discover-next, /discover-batch and /stories return ONLY kind='story'; (c) premium user with modes=['lessons'] → same endpoints return ONLY kind='lesson'; (d) premium user with both modes gets a subset of {story,lesson}. Frontend at 390x844 (guest flow): (1) onboarding-chip-lessons carries the lucchetto (onboarding-chip-lessons-lock present); tapping the chip surfaces topics-limit-toast with text 'Mini lessons: Premium only · Curiosities are always free. Guided mini lessons unlock with Premium.' (English locale); selecting 6 specific categories triggers no error toast and interests-count shows no 'max 4' phrasing. (2) Continuing to Home with chip-all selected renders home-explore-tile (label 'EXPLORE', home-explore-art visible, home-explore-sub 'Every category is a discovery'), and home-category-carousel is absent; tapping the tile navigates to /explore and mounts explore-screen. (3) On the Explore tab, explore-chip-lessons is present with explore-chip-lessons-lock; tapping it navigates to /premium; interests-count reads '12 active interests' (no 'max 4'). (4) Home credits: with credits<capacity (consumed 1 credit via POST /api/user/complete so state.credits=3), home-credits-timer is NOT visible initially; first tap on home-credits reveals home-credits-timer (text '1:59:56'), second tap navigates to /read-stories; on /read-stories the recap card renders category + title with NO 'Remember this'/'Da ricordare' text. (5) Home→reader morph: tapping home-story-<id>-open shows morph-host immediately, URL becomes /deep-dive/<id>?morph=1&rect=..., deep-dive-scroll mounts and morph-host disappears within ~2s; the header back button uses browser history (no dedicated deep-dive-back testID) — page.go_back() returns to /discover with no morph-host residue; repeated open→scroll→close cycle also clean. (6) deep-dive-ending: summary-card (105-255), deep-dive-actions (279-329), next-story (368-516) and ending-home-btn / ending-read-btn (576-624) all fit within the 844 viewport with margin — nothing cropped. ending-home-btn navigates back to Home. (7) /premium compare table: compare-school-outline present (row 'Mini lessons — Guided step-by-step deep-dives — Free: — / Premium: ✓'), compare-musical-notes-outline and compare-compass-outline are absent, and no '10 min' text is found in any compare row. (8) Profile mode-switch-lessons: aria-checked='false' for the free user; tapping the row navigates to /premium. ONE new backend leak discovered while browsing the reader (see backend_issues.minor): /api/stories/{id}/next does not apply _kind_filter, so a free user still receives a lesson-kind story as their 'Next discovery' preview (curl on /stories/v5-noia/next returns v7-lez-orientarsi-senza-gps kind='lesson'). This is not covered by the requested test list but is a real gap in the Premium-lessons gating. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

minor.issue: Handler skips _kind_filter, so free users (or any content_modes selection) can receive kind='lesson' stories in the 'Next discovery' preview. Repro: curl '.../api/stories/<any_story_id>/next?user_id=<free_user>' can return {'kind':'lesson'}. This breaks the 'Mini lessons are Premium-only' guarantee end-to-end, since reader-ending renders the returned preview as a NEXT DISCOVERY card and ending-read-btn navigates the free reader straight into a lesson. Fix: mirror discover_next — load the user_state and add query.update(_kind_filter(state)) to every candidate lookup (related fallback, category fallback, interests fallback, global fallback).

integration_issues.flow: reader-ending / next-story preview for free users
integration_issues.issue: The NEXT DISCOVERY card in the ending shows a MINI LESSON badge for a free user because /api/stories/{id}/next returned a lesson-kind story. Root cause is backend (see backend_issues.minor). No frontend change needed once the backend applies _kind_filter.

action_items: Backend: apply _kind_filter inside next_story() (server.py:740-773). Load state = await db.user_state.find_one({user_id: user_id}) at the top and merge _kind_filter(state) into each of the four candidate queries (related loop can post-filter the doc; category / interests / global find_one calls should include {**query, **_kind_filter(state)}). Add a pytest asserting that a free user with content_modes=['lessons'] gets kind='story' from /stories/<lesson_or_story_id>/next.

(Optional, low priority) /api/stories/{id}/related also does not accept a user_id / apply _kind_filter. It is not currently rendered to free users in the ending screen, but if it starts to be, the same leak would appear.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_kind_filter correctly forces {'kind':'story'} for is_premium=false regardless of content_modes; discover-next, discover-batch, /stories, /playlist all merge it in. next_story() is the only public reader-facing endpoint missing this merge — the smoke check on the ending screen surfaced it immediately.
server.py:set_interests: FREE_TOPICS_LIMIT / topics_limit HTTP 402 branch has been removed; the endpoint now always returns 200. Matches iter-5 spec.

recap-card.tsx renders only StoryHero + category + title (no styles.body / summary block). Same component is shared by /pause-limit and /read-stories.

home-controls.tsx:HomeExploreTile has testIDs home-explore-tile / home-explore-label / home-explore-sub / home-explore-art; CategoryArtMark is positioned absolute with negative top/right so the 3D icon sporge above the tile as specified.

onboarding-modes.tsx:ModeChips renders lucchetto (Ionicons name='lock-closed') with testID '{idPrefix}-chip-{k}-lock' when the mode is in `locked`. Onboarding & Explore both pass locked={new Set(['lessons'])} for non-premium users; the two ends of the flow are consistent.

premium.tsx rows[] includes school-outline (Mini lessons: free false / premium true) and no longer contains musical-notes-outline (playlist 10 min) or compass-outline (active topics). All compare rows stamp testID='compare-<icon>' for easy assertion.

reader-ending.tsx section uses maxWidth=READER_MAX_W, paddingTop=spacing.sm and gap=spacing.sm; on 390x844 all five sub-elements fit within the viewport with the buttons at 576-624 leaving ~220px of bottom breathing room (screenshot confirmed).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview: https://pause-preview-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Guest flow (no localStorage): app boots on onboarding-profile — click onboarding-profile-continue → onboarding-chip-lessons has -lock icon (tap raises topics-limit-toast with 'Mini lessons: Premium only') → pick any specific chips and/or chip-all → onboarding-continue → Home. To exercise the credit badge timer: consume ≥1 credit via `POST /api/user/complete {user_id, story_id}` using the localStorage user_id (key 'pause.user_id') and one of the ids from GET /api/stories; after reloading, home-credits-timer is hidden and the first tap on home-credits reveals it, second tap routes to /read-stories. Reader back button has NO dedicated testID (uses router history); use page.go_back() in tests. To exercise /stories/{id}/next leak: curl the endpoint for any story id with a free user_id — currently can return kind='lesson' (bug filed).
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the mini-lessons leak in /api/stories/{story_id}/next: the handler predates _kind_filter and hand-rolls its own candidate cascade (related index → same category → interests → global). None of the four Mongo lookups get the {kind: 'story'} filter merged in for free users. Reproduction: (1) start a fresh guest, (2) POST /api/user/complete with a curiosity id, (3) hit GET /api/stories/<that_id>/next?user_id=<uid> — response has kind='lesson' (verified with v5-noia → v7-lez-orientarsi-senza-gps). Mitigation: at the top of next_story(), reuse the same pattern discover_next() uses: `state = await db.user_state.find_one(...)` then `kf = _kind_filter(state)` and merge kf into every candidate query (including the related-index loop, which currently returns any related doc without honouring kind).
